module: Modifies the terrain (TerrainBlock) to fit the Road Architect roads: flattens the terrain under a road or road network (with a domain of influence and a margin), computes road masks, and imports/exports the heightmap as a 16-bit PNG. Used by the Road Architect UI and by road network imports. All functions return without doing anything if the scene has no TerrainBlock (e.g. smallgrid).
usage:
local tf = extensions.editor_roadArchitect_terraform
tf.terraformMultiRoads(30, 1.0, nil)  -- whole network, domain of influence 30 m, margin 1 m
notes: The domain of influence (DOI) is bounded to a minimum of 5 m (max(5, DOI)).
An undo callback (terraformUndo) exists internally to restore the modified heights.

conformTerrainToRoad and terraformMultiRoads use a fallback TerrainEditor (TerrainEditor()) if the terrain editor is not open; writeHeightmapToPng, setHeightmapFromPng and getRoadMasks require extensions.editor_terrainEditor and exit otherwise.
setHeightmapFromPng: if loading the PNG fails, the code logs an error but still continues the application loop (no return); the bitmap used is then not valid.
writeHeightmapToPng returns {} when there is no terrain, and nothing otherwise (inconsistent return value).
The PNG is in GFXFormatR16; the scale goes from the terrain base height (tb:getPosition().z) to tb.maxHeight.

conformTerrainToRoad.desc: Flattens the local terrain so that it hugs a road: computes the road's quads, a mask and fixed heights, averages with the neighbors then writes the terrain. The extent is the road's 2D box enlarged by the DOI.

rIdx.desc: Index of the road in roads.

DOI.desc: Domain of influence (fade distance), in meters, minimum 5.

margin.desc: Margin around the road (inferred from code: mask dilation).

terraformMultiRoads.desc: Shapes the terrain over the whole road network, or over the indicated group. First recomputes all renderData. Includes neither overlays nor bridges.

margin.desc: Margin around the roads (inferred from code).

group.desc: Placed group, or nil for the whole network.

writeHeightmapToPng.desc: Saves the terrain heightmap to a 16-bit PNG file (negative heights clamped to 0).

path.desc: Path of the .png file to write.

returns.desc: {} if there is no terrain, otherwise nil.

setHeightmapFromPng.desc: Applies a PNG heightmap to the terrain (cell by cell) then updates the TerrainBlock grid.

getRoadMasks.desc: Computes two masks on the terrain grid: a mask of the roads alone (value 65535 where a road covers the point, dilated by 1 cell) and a roads + margin mask (dilation by margin).

DOI.desc: Domain of influence, in meters (minimum 5); used to extend the search box.

margin.desc: Number of dilation cells of the margin mask (inferred from code).

group.desc: Placed group, or nil for all roads.

returns.desc: Road mask indexed [x][y] (0 or 65535); nil if there is no terrain.
